games.name: (PT3!!) Critical Revengeance
games.desc:
Welcome to Critical Revengeance! An open-world game that is a harder spin on the CA Genre (Although still heavily WIP.)

Please be aware that (MOST) of the songs in CR are from outside sources and are not original, and upon request will be removed if need be.
We DO have some official OSTs though.
AZALI has granted us permission to use their songs, as long as it isn't a commissioned song.

This game is still in public testing phases, so expect MANY bugs, unfinished content, a lack of content, incorrect balancing, and anything to change. This game is mostly meant for PC, but it has some mobile and console support.

This game is developed by two people, one working on a backend recode. Game is still getting updated during recode period. Please know that updates will be way slower and inconsistent, and is a passion project.

games.name: 🌾 Village & Mount Pamali
games.desc:
⛰️ Mount Horror - A mountain that must not be crossed ⛰️ 
Not an ordinary climb. Fog, forests, and deserted trails hide forgotten prohibitions. Every step can be an invitation for those waiting in the dark. Wear headphones. Don't climb alone if you're not mentally prepared.

🎮 Main Gameplay Features 
→ 🌲 Horror mountain trail, checkpoint to the summit 
→ 🔦 Darkness, flashlight, stamina & water need to be managed 
→ 👻 Jump scares and chases: pocong, kunti, and other ghosts 
→ 🙏 Sasajen missions, rituals, and puzzles on the path 
→ 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Friend mode: carrying the exhausted or "in the mood" 
→ 🏃‍♀️ Sprint when you need to flee - the atmosphere can change at any moment 

🙏 Keep supporting so that this project can grow and become more popular in the future.

games.name: Mega Escape: Squid Game 3 season
games.desc:
Do you enjoy awesome cutscenes and story, obby and parkour, or beating monsters and bosses? Then this game is for you.
This is a story about you being dragged into a Squid Game. It does not proceed fairly, rules and safety are disregarded. Face monsters, war machines, rising lava and other hazards. Survive and win despite all odds.

Latest Update July 2025
Added some new parkour sections and a new boss fight.

This game features:
- Engaging parkour and puzzles
- Interactions - switches, levers, buttons and pushable objects
- Map of the game which you can use to teleport. Saves progress!
- Numerous enemies - ranged, jumping and even self-exploding
- Several types of weapons
- Upgrades
- Epic boss fights
- Awesome cutscenes
